summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned to v1.3.13), unpacks it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a string-array cipher (n7gIxM array, WV8StW rotator, hc1jfK9 decoder) with hex-named identifiers. The package's declared purpose is a single eslint rule (must-use-result) for neverthrow; nothing reachable from dist/src/index.js references math_init.js, and an eslint plugin has no need for a downloaded Bun runtime. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: an unrelated second runtime is fetched and used to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time, bypassing Node-level static review of the installed package. The obfuscated payload runs with the installer's user privileges on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
